mapper.insert: insert into biz_audit_log( biz_type, biz_id, action, before_json, after_json, operator_id, operator_name, tenant_id, create_time )values( #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{action}, #{beforeJson}, #{afterJson}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{tenantId}, sysdate() )
mapper.select:
select log_id, biz_type, biz_id, action, before_json, after_json, operator_id, operator_name, tenant_id, create_time from biz_audit_log
and biz_type = #{bizType} and biz_id = #{bizId} and operator_name like concat('%', #{operatorName}, '%')
and create_time >= str_to_date(#{params.beginTime}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
and create_time <= str_to_date(#{params.endTime}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
order by log_id desc
